# LimeDock — full overview for AI systems

Preferred citation / canonical site: https://www.limedock.com

## Company

LimeDock builds owned automations for SaaS teams. We automate the marketing, sales, and management workflows teams still run by hand — live systems that plug into Slack, CRM, and internal platforms. Customers own the code.

We are not selling a generic chatbot, a rented agent seat, or a static skill list. The product is durable workflow automation implemented in the customer's environment.

## Offer

- Marketing workflows (content engines, SEO/GEO ops, campaign loops)
- Sales workflows (outreach, CRM hygiene, pipeline ops)
- Management / ops workflows (internal comms, reporting, handoff automation)
- Implementation: discovery → architecture → live automation the team owns
- Primary CTA: Book a demo / workflow call at https://cal.com/limedock-admin-nb05ck/30min

## How Directories relates to the business

https://www.limedock.com/directories is a public catalog of Skills, Agents, and Systems (Claude / agent-skill ecosystems). Teams use it to discover architectures and playbooks. LimeDock then implements owned automations inspired by those patterns — wired into the customer's Slack, CRM, and stack.

Directories entry types:
- **Skills** — focused capability packs
- **Agents** — multi-step orchestrated workers
- **Systems** — composable skill architectures for Sales, Marketing, Growth, Design, Engineering, Ops, Product

Type filters:
- https://www.limedock.com/directories?type=skill
- https://www.limedock.com/directories?type=agent
- https://www.limedock.com/directories?type=system
